dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I was just thinking about finding a patch of grass to lie down if you don't need me for anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Hmm, I quite like the environment. The temperature and humidity are both near perfect. It's a very fitting place for a leisurely vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You really are quite something, to possess such a cozy and comfortable haven, but still be willing to venture out into the unknown.

choices.text: There are some things that I must do.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You speak with conviction. I can tell those matters are extremely important to you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's not a bad thing to be committed to a goal. It can prevent you from losing your way in life.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But don't let your convictions control you and lead you down a dangerous path, okay?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: After all, this wonderful place is still waiting for your return.

choices.text: Life is all about being on the move.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Huh, I like the sound of that phrase. I just might write it down and add it to one of the regulations at the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Should I say that it came from you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope, that responsibility's all yours.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Ahh, you saw right through me.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Don't worry, though. I was just joking around.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If I was actually going to add some new kind of rule, I will be sure to take full responsibility for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sure. Got anything on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Talking about the weather is usually a great way to get a conversation going, but it seems like the weather here is always the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's the work of Tubby, the teapot spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I see, so the keeper of this place is a teapot spirit...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: When I first arrived, I had actually mistaken her for one of those large finchbill pets.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Yeah, you're right.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I actually made a similar mistake when I was young. I once thought that Melusines were the form that sea hares took when they hopped onto land.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It wasn't until I read some books that I realized just how silly I was.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You should know that according to laws and regulations, Melusines are also recognized citizens of Fontaine. It is forbidden to view or treat them as pets or monsters.

choices.text: I figured it was something like that.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Good, that makes for one less legal trouble you may get yourself into.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Although it'd be great to have more people working in the Fortress, I've never been interested in instigating crime.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It is my hope that people will use more legitimate channels to find work in the Fortress of Meropide. There's no need to cause headaches for the upstanding ladies and gentlemen of the Palais Mermonia.

choices.text: First time I've ever heard of it...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I believe you owe me a big thank-you, then.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Criminals that disrespect Melusines usually get slapped with a pretty hefty sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'd like to take a quick walk around here. Would you mind?

choices.text: Not at all. It's not like I can keep you in my sights all the time anyway.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Our combat abilities aside, I will definitely stay put if that's what you prefer.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: However, you've also gotten to know me a bit by now. It's true that I'm not accustomed to staying in an unfamiliar place for long.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But this is your home. We don't have to worry about danger here, right?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm curious, that's all. I just want to take a walk around this vast, miraculous place as if I were a tourist.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can show you some other teapot realms, too, if you'd like.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Wait, really?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, as long as you wish it, you can visit each of the seven nations without ever having to step outside?

choices.text: Want to give it a try?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, well, opportunities like that don't just come by every day.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If you want something, you should try your best to fight for it, won't you agree?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it, I'll go switch up the realms for you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And I would be ever so grateful.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Obviously, I am also aware that there is no such thing as a free lunch.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, if you are ever in need of my help, don't let anything hold you back. We will always welcome you at the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, with that said, I hope you won't be coming down because of a new sentence.

choices.text: I can already see your excitement.
I figured you would've already explored the place.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That would have been true if we were elsewhere... Making sure that my surroundings are safe is essential.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Your Grace.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It's not every day that we get to meet in the overworld. There's no need to be so formal.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Morning. I hope you'll have a wonderful day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Wriothesley.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Good night.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The daytime hours are always full of sound and fury, so I've developed a habit of saving work that requires more considered thinking for the evening.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: However... I'll pass on that while I'm here. Allow me to space out for a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Not bad. It really looks the part.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Anyone who gets to compete in a tournament here must be the cream of the crop, since you're the one sending out the invitations.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: So, I'll pass — save myself the embarrassment. Besides... I make a good spectator.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were trying to coax me into working from your place so you can pry into the Fortress of Meropide's most closely guarded secrets...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Well, I hate to break it to you, but the majority of my day-to-day work is mundane accounting.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: So I could consider working here, but only if... Well, let's put it this way — how good's your math?
